gap.name: RipenessDependentSeparation
gap.mismatch: T0 predicts clean halves; on firm fruit 50 of 60 episodes end {'torn': 31, 'not edible': 10, 'seed coat left': 9}

hypotheses.h: H1 ripeness controls whether the flesh releases at the seed
hypotheses.test: vary stage 1.5-4.5 at a full cut (200 dev fruit)
hypotheses.result: P(clean) rises from 0.09 (stage < 2.3) to 0.97 (stage > 3.3); fitted logistic centre 2.72, width 0.25 (plant law: 2.8, 0.15)

hypotheses.h: H2 an incomplete cut leaves bridges that tear
hypotheses.test: vary coverage 300 / 330 / 360 deg on ripe fruit
hypotheses.result: 300 deg: torn 30, stuck 0 /30; 330 deg: torn 30, stuck 0 /30; 360 deg: torn 0, stuck 0 /30
hypotheses.verdict: supported as a second cause: a gap in the cut tears the bridge even on ripe fruit; T0 already has the distinction (Scored / PartlyScored) and the re-cut repair, so it adds no gap

hypotheses.h: H3 too much twist torque tears the flesh
hypotheses.test: vary the torque limit 0.3 / 1.5 / 3 N m on breaking fruit
hypotheses.result: 0.3 N m: torn 10, stuck 0 /30; 1.5 N m: torn 10, stuck 0 /30; 3.0 N m: torn 10, stuck 0 /30
hypotheses.verdict: rejected: the share of torn fruit does not change with the torque limit

dA: P(clean | stage) = logistic(stage; s0, w), fitted
stage advances at the fruit's own rate (lifetime model)
patch.rationale: discriminating experiments support H1; the claim is specialised by a cut-day plan module (wait into the band) and verified on held-out fruit

steps.request: Pit it; the cavity must be clean.

gap.name: SeedCoatUnrepresented
gap.mismatch: T1 predicts a clean cavity; 51 of 90 episodes leave seed-coat sheets ({'seed coat left': 51})

hypotheses.h: H1 the seed coat sticks to the flesh in some fruit (a hidden property of the fruit)
hypotheses.test: same fruit pitted with spoon and with knife twist (60 dev fruit)
hypotheses.result: cavity outcome identical across methods in 60 of 60 fruit; seed coat left in 0.53 of them

hypotheses.h: H2 the spoon technique leaves the coat
repair: the spoon tip lifts the sheets
hypotheses.test: one peel pass on 28 dev cavities with sheets

dA: the seed coat stays in the cavity when it adheres to the flesh
a spoon-tip pass lifts the sheets
patch.rationale: the distinction is perceivable after pitting and actionable by a repair

gap.name: ColourRipenessMisspecified
gap.mismatch: under the new camera 3 of 30 ripe fruit fail ({'overripe': 2, 'spoiled': 1}): the photo says firmer than it is

hypotheses.h: H1 the camera's lightness is biased
hypotheses.test: photo L* against the stage implied by a gentle squeeze (60 dev fruit)
hypotheses.result: mean residual +10.4 L* units (simulated camera bias +10)

hypotheses.test: the same residual on day 0, before any ripening
hypotheses.result: the residual is present before any time passes

dA: photo lightness offset of this camera
patch.rationale: photo-only ripeness no longer suffices for commitment (scope restricted to photo + touch); the observation model is versioned with the estimated bias

steps.request: Keep the other half for tomorrow's breakfast.

gap.name: BrowningUnrepresented
gap.mismatch: T3 has no browning: 90 of 90 kept halves are brown after 15 h ({'ok': 88, 'seed coat left': 2})

hypotheses.h: H1 exposed flesh browns over hours unless covered, acidified or cooled
hypotheses.test: lifetime model (dE = k sqrt(t), treatment factors; atk_browning ordering)
hypotheses.result: untreated dE reaches the visible level within ~3 h; lemon + wrap + fridge stays below it for > 15 h

dA: dE = k sqrt(t x treatment factor)
patch.rationale: the treatment action prevents the forbidden effect
